title: 第764章 买军弩第763章 清晏真人
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
方闻舟坐在三山镇镇衙内，下面站着几名文吏，正一个个汇报。
“监镇，如今秋收已过，应该让人去看看去年修的水库、沟渠、堤坝了。
那些水库堤坝还是为了防洪仓促修的，如今过两年，该稍微整备一下。”
方闻舟抬眼：“需要多少人力？多长时间？”
“百人三十日足以，镇上管饭就行，不用给工钱，百姓都愿意去。”
见识了那些水库的好处，镇上百姓自然都乐意去修水利。
方闻舟并未答话，而是向下首另一个文吏问道：“铁门寨今年的产矿量可足了？”
这是他从赵氏要来的人，专管铁门寨事，可以说是真正的自己人。
那小吏立刻站起身回话道：“只达到了八成，想完成的话，得在入冬前加紧工期了。”
方闻舟这才看向刚开始说要整修水利的人道：“两年前才修的，不急于一时，明年再说吧。”
为了拿下铁门寨的全部份额，家里让出了一座小矿，赵昭远也需要证明他这一趟不是白来的，自然把产量定得比原本高了不少。
赵昭远给一个数，那要头疼的便是方闻舟了，原本的矿奴已经不够用，他已经征召了不少百姓上山挖矿，实在抽不出百来人再整备水利了。
最开始说要整修的人，也就不再多话。
修水利的事情是江尘临走时交代的，也是原本的计划。
可如今的监镇是方闻舟，他一个小吏，说了也不算，提一句，就算是尽了本分了。
之后其他几人，要各自上前汇报，说的多是百姓的不满，还有李家也有新的要求。
方闻舟听了许久，开口道：“把这几家的名姓、地址都给我，我抽时间会亲自过去看看的。”
赵昭远和家族的要求，他躲不了。但对于这些琐碎的事情，他还是愿意上心的，否则也不至于如此疲累。
众人说了许久，等一众小吏离开后。
方闻舟才知道胡四海回来了，连忙将胡四海请来。

见到人之后，打起精神道：“胡掌柜，你这终于回来了。”
胡四海苦笑摇头：“禀监镇，苏绰部那边不必说了，不会向外出售战马，我只带回来了几十匹驽马，可充作役畜，用于搬运。”
他也知道，方闻舟最关心的就是这个，所以一上来便把结果说了。
方闻舟表情稍带失望，但最终还是点点头说道：“倒也是正常。”
从三山镇往北狄的商路一直是胡四海管着，这也是江尘和赵昭远定下的。
甚至为了保证商路的秘密，进了大黑山之后，就让北狄人过来接应，自己只带部分亲信进入北狄部落。
如今已过了一年多，方闻舟硬是不知道商道后半段怎么走，也不知道该怎么和北狄人接洽，到现在还是只能指望胡四海。
方闻舟：“其他的货物可入库了？”
胡四海点点头道：“有半数要运到和朔县去，剩下半数已入了县库。”
方闻舟微微颔首，再不说话。
他对其他换来的货物也不甚在意，牛羊肉、皮毛运到县城去，能换回来不少布匹资粮，虽是有用，对他却没有太大的用处。
可家族最催促的是铁料和马匹，铁料他可以多叫些人上去挖矿，可马匹只能指望北狄部落松口了。
想了想，他还是对胡四海说道：“胡掌柜，如果能换来马匹，你可以告诉他们，我们可以出更高的价钱。”
“恐怕有些难。战马向来是战略物资，他们不会往外发卖的，而且北狄王庭那边最近好像有动静，在抽调各部落的战马。”
方闻舟看不到一点希望，再次唉声叹气起来。
可余光一转，又见到胡四海表情犹豫，心中没由来地生出一抹希望：“胡掌柜有什么话尽管说，是不是他们有别的要求？”
胡四海这才开口说道：“不是北狄，我这次去，碰见了赵国的商队。他们说有办法弄来一批战马。”
方闻舟表情大喜，当即起身：“果真吗？赵国的战马比北狄可丝毫不差。他们能弄来多少？”
“大概一百匹。”
content_en:
Fang Wenzhou was sitting in the Sanshan Town government office, with several clerks standing below him, reporting one by one.
“Jianzhen, now that the autumn harvest has passed, it’s time for people to take a look at the reservoirs, ditches, and dams built last year.
Those reservoirs and dams were hastily built for flood control. Now, after two years, they should be slightly repaired. "
Fang Wenzhou raised his eyes: "How much manpower is needed? How long will it take?"
"Thirty days for a hundred people is enough. The town can take care of the food. No wages are required, and the people are willing to go."
After seeing the benefits of those reservoirs, the people in the town were naturally willing to build water conservancy projects.
Fang Wenzhou did not answer, but looked down at another clerk and asked, "Will Tiemen Village's mineral production be sufficient this year?"
This is the person he wanted from the Zhao family, who specializes in the affairs of Tiemen Village. He can be said to be a true one of his own.
The clerk immediately stood up and replied: "It's only 80% completed. If you want to complete it, you have to speed up the construction period before winter."
Fang Wenzhou then looked at the man who had just said that he wanted to renovate the water conservancy project: "It was only built two years ago. Don't rush it. Let's talk about it next year."
In order to obtain the entire share of Tiemenshai, the family gave up a small mine. Zhao Zhaoyuan also needed to prove that his trip was not in vain, so naturally the output was set much higher than originally.
Zhao Zhaoyuan gave a number, and it was Fang Wenzhou who had a headache. The original mining slaves were no longer enough. He had already recruited many people to dig in the mountains, and he really couldn't spare a hundred people to prepare for water conservancy.
The person who said it was going to be renovated in the first place stopped talking.
The matter of repairing water conservancy was what Jiang Chen told him before he left, and it was also the original plan.
But the current supervisor is Fang Wenzhou. He is a small official, and even if he says it, he has done his duty.
After that, several other people had to come forward to report. Most of what they said was the dissatisfaction of the people, and the Li family also had new demands.
Fang Wenzhou listened for a long time and then said: "Give me the names, surnames and addresses of these families. I will take a look at them in person when I have time."
He could not avoid the demands of Zhao Zhaoyuan and his family. But he was still willing to pay attention to these trivial things, otherwise he wouldn't be so tired.
Everyone talked for a long time and waited for the small officials to leave.
Only then did Fang Wenzhou know that Hu Sihai was back, and he quickly invited Hu Sihai over.
After seeing the person, he cheered up and said, "Shopkeeper Hu, you are finally back."
Hu Sihai smiled bitterly and shook his head: "Needless to say, the Su Chuo Department in Zhenjian Town will not sell war horses to outsiders. I only brought back a few dozen horses, which can be used as draft animals for transportation."
He also knew that this was what Fang Wenzhou was most concerned about, so he told the result right away.
Fang Wenzhou looked slightly disappointed, but in the end he nodded and said, "That's normal."
The trade route from Sanshan Town to Beidi has always been under the control of Hu Sihai, which was also decided by Jiang Chen and Zhao Zhaoyuan.
In order to ensure the secrecy of the trade route, after entering the Daheishan Mountains, he asked the Beidi people to come over to help him, and he only brought some of his close associates into the Beidi tribe.
Now more than a year has passed, and Fang Wenzhou still doesn't know how to take the second half of the business road, nor does he know how to contact the Beidi people. Up to now, he can only count on Hu Sihai.
Fang Wenzhou: “Can other goods be put into storage?”
Hu Sihai nodded and said: "Half of it will be transported to Heshuo County, and the remaining half has been put into the county treasury."
Fang Wenzhou nodded slightly and said nothing.
He didn't pay much attention to the other goods in exchange. When beef, mutton, and furs were transported to the county town, he could get back a lot of cloth and food. Although they were useful, they were of little use to him.
But what the family was most pressing for was iron and horses. For iron, he could ask more people to dig for it, but for the horses, he could only hope that the Beidi tribe would relent.
After thinking about it, he still said to Hu Sihai: "Shopkeeper Hu, if you can get horses in exchange, you can tell them that we can offer a higher price."
"I'm afraid it's a bit difficult. War horses have always been strategic materials, and they won't sell them outside.Moreover, there seems to be some movement in Beidi Royal Court recently, and they are deploying war horses from various tribes. "
Fang Wenzhou couldn't see any hope and sighed again.
But when I turned my peripheral vision, I saw Hu Sihai's hesitant expression again, and a glimmer of hope arose in my heart for no reason: "Shopkeeper Hu, just say whatever you want, do they have other requests? "
Hu Sihai then said: "It's not Beidi. This time I went and met Zhao's caravan. They said there was a way to get a group of war horses. "
Fang Wenzhou looked overjoyed and stood up immediately: "Is it true? Zhao's war horses are no worse than Beidi's. How many can they get? "
"About a hundred. "
